title: FareShare: A Tool for Labor Organizers to Estimate Lost Wages and Contest Arbitrary AI and Algorithmic Deactivations
reasoning: The paper focuses on a computational tool (FareShare) designed to assist labor organizers in contesting algorithmic deactivations of gig workers. While it discusses algorithmic harms and procedural fairness in labor contexts, and includes mentions of ethical considerations regarding research consent, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
